algebraic_discharge_rule: If the supplied operator is zero-preserving and the kernel measure and normalization are finite, then substituting Phi_lens_tau=0 gives tau_PP_tau_contribution(L)=0 for every L.
blocked_shortcuts: do not use the synthetic zero-control route as proof of the physical projection operator
do not infer zero-source behavior from a scored residual
do not hide a nonzero additive Tau term inside the fiducial PP baseline
scaffold_equation: tau_PP(L) = N_projection_physical * Integral[K_tau_PP(L; a,k) Phi_lens_tau(a,k) dmu(a,k)]

sufficient_conditions.requirement: Projection_PP[0](L)=0, or every nonlinear term contains at least one Phi_lens_tau factor and no source-independent additive term.
K_tau_PP(L; a,k)dmu(a,k) is finite/integrable on the declared support for each L=10..3009.
N_projection_physical is finite and fixed before endpoint comparison.
Any fiducial PP baseline is outside the Tau contribution and is not counted as nonzero Tau response.
If using delta_PP_tau, the zero-source limit applies to delta_PP_tau(L), not to the fiducial PP baseline.
